tenderSchedule.title: APPOINTMENT OF RPTOs FOR CONDUCTING SPECIALIZED RPAs TRAINING AIMED AT GENERATING ENTREPRENEURS AND CREATING EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES FOR MINORITY CANDIDATES
tenderSchedule.description: The Director , Directorate of Minorities , Minority Welfare Dept. is inviting Short Term e-Tender for Appointment of RPTOs for conducting specialized drone training aimed At generating entrepreneurs and creating employment opportunities in various Sectors For Minority Candidates under two cover system (Technical Bid and Financial Bid) from service providers who have adequate resources and experience

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Directorate of Minorities, Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C, Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All bidders shall be deemed to have read, understood and accepted the tender conditions and shall comply with all requirements specified therein, including subsequent amendments and clarifications.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidding firm must have successfully trained Drone Pilot training program to a minimum of 300 students through offline mode in their RPTO Location. The above requirement shall be fulfilled during the last Three (3) financial years, namely 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

itemList.itemName: The total cost quoted per candidate for the training programme shall be inclusive of all components and services, including theoretical training, practical training, simulation training, hands-on training, online assessments, certification, boarding and lodging facilities (including food), and one complete set of training/study materials. No additional charges shall be payable towards any of the above components.
